protocol.percentile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; retain every raw value
protocol.cold: fresh Chromium process and context; OS disk cache NOT cleared
protocol.warm: reload same page/context after cold sample
protocol.startupClock: navigation time origin through API ready, fonts.ready, image decode, video metadata, two animation frames and selection
protocol.input: synthetic public Engine text commit through paint; NOT physical typing or IME
protocol.drag: Playwright pointer gesture with 10 moves; gesture duration and rAF intervals separately; NOT single-event feedback latency
protocol.media: muted play/pause, leave/return, metadata and two animation frames
protocol.save: checkpoint build/download initiation; byte-exact reopened document checked outside timing; NOT filesystem flush
protocol.freezeRule: Version budgets before measurement; never raise thresholds in response to failed samples. Compare only matching device/browser/resource/font/viewport/corpus/protocol pins. 100 pages is exploratory, not supported capacity.
